title: Pro-Israel group protests outside Green Party conference in Brighton
seoTitle: Brighton protest at Green Party conference

tea.why: Green Party members were due to vote on a motion declaring Zionism a form of racism.
tea.want: Protesters opposed the motion and its adoption by the party.
tea.changed: Oct 3: dozens of pro-Israel demonstrators gathered outside the Brighton Centre as members arrived.

summary: Dozens of pro-Israel demonstrators protested outside the Green Party's conference at the Brighton Centre on October 3, ahead of a vote on a motion calling for Zionism to be declared a form of racism. The group Stop the Hate, which describes itself as a Jewish-led direct action campaign, gathered from about 11am and chanted at members entering the venue; Middle East Eye reported chants including 'Terrorist supporters off our streets'. A Brighton Green Party member described some of the protesters' views as extremist. The motion's vote was scheduled for the following day.
response: No police or party statement on the protest is reported in the sources.

updates.text: Stop the Hate members protested outside the Brighton Centre as the Green conference met.
